docs.title: HCableAnalysis
docs.text:
A Python framework for suspension bridge cable analysis.

HCableAnalysis is developed by Structural Simulation Lab for suspension bridge cable modeling, shape finding, and finite element preprocessing. It provides an efficient workflow from parameter definition to numerical analysis.

docs.title: Features
docs.text: - **Shape Finding** — Determine initial cable geometry under dead load. - **Parametric Modeling** — Define cable parameters programmatically. - **Loading Conditions** — Dead, live, temperature, and wind loads. - **FEA Integration** — Export to ANSYS and Abaqus. - **Benchmark Validation** — Verify against published solutions. - **Excel Input** — Import geometry and loading data. - **DXF Export** — Export geometry for CAD integration.
